rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken verb for beating or outperforming a person or competitor.

example.english: I excel at running and beat him.
example.jyutping: ngo5 paau2 bou6 jeng4 gwo3 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when saying that someone or something is the best in a particular ability or field.

example.english: Ming is the best at football in our class; he really does excel at it.
example.traditional: 我哋班入面，阿明踢波最叻。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 baan1 jap6 min6 aa3 ming4 tek3 bo1 zeoi3 lek1

rows.note: Use this when someone performs noticeably better than their own previous standard.

example.english: I excel when I surpass my previous standard, and I finally got a high mark this time.
example.traditional: 今次考試我突破自己，終於攞到高分。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ngo5 dat6 po3 zi6 gei2 zung1 jyu1 lo2 dou3 gou1 fan1
